description: Land Acquisition - Tahalahagama, Athuraliya D/S Division, Matara District and two other acquirements in Kandy & Matara Districts
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of land acquisition declarations under the Land Acquisition Act. It describes specific parcels of land being acquired for public purposes, including detailed descriptions of land boundaries, extents, locations, and survey information. The content falls squarely within the definition of Type 4 (Land Gazettes) as it deals with land acquisitions and property matters, not government personnel changes or structural modifications.
